review.confirmation: Adopt toàn bộ C/P/I trong bảng và exact bounded history model nói trên, chỉ trong phạm vi proposal/pins đã review. Natural-password AS-REP/TGS recovery và các classes khác không được adoption bởi quyết định này. Known-FALSE veto và production provider checks tiếp tục áp dụng.

scope_adoption.rationale: Apply the same ordinal reset/activation operation rubric to direct User or explicitly usable Computer principals, at one same-domain Computer context. The controller kind changes applicability, not the operation price. This is an opt-in solo-fork scenario estimate, not observed duration or historical reviewer approval of this scope. One successful operation per canonical work unit; retries/time not modeled. Local host control alone is insufficient. An actor-to-User canonical grant may be inherited; effective permission is already a conditioned prerequisite. Group/derived rights remain unpriced.
